origin.description: Maximize the Haslett-Raftery likelihood for the fractional difference.
origin.usage: fracdiff(x, nar = 0, nma = 0, ar = rep(NA, max(nar, 1)), ma = rep(NA, max(nma, 1)), dtol = NULL, drange = c(0, 0.5), h, M = 100, trace = 0)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric series. Missing values are an error.

arguments.name: drange
arguments.text: The interval searched for d. The default is 0 to 1/2.

arguments.name: M
arguments.text: Terms kept in the likelihood approximation. In Python the argument is m.

origin.details: The search is Brent's method. The log likelihood adds the literal 2.8378 to the log of the filtered variance. A positive nar or nma is still the original MINPACK fit and is not available here. The moving-average sign, when that order is used in R, is the opposite of stats::arima.
origin.value: d, the log likelihood, the innovation standard deviation, and the standard error of d.
origin.example: fit <- fracdiff(sin(1:40) + 0.3 * cos((1:40) / 3)); cat(fit$d, fit$log.likelihood, fit$sigma, "\n")
